human_recognizability.finding: Native #117/#264/#966 show clothed bodies, heads and limbs, with multiple static appearances/yaws. Far/nadir bodies are resolution-limited, and all eight share one template.

lighting_realism.finding: Directional lighting, subdued warm morning/evening and neutral noon give grounded shading; no calibrated atmospheric/sky model.

scene_plausibility.finding: Single, crowds and person/vehicle scenes are grounded and physically separated, with outdoor context. Layouts do not model real traffic/crowd behavior. 111/2000 high/oblique frames expose environment background at corners, at most 5.53% of image pixels.

shadow_realism.finding: Trees, vehicles, canopies and wall cast localized shadows. Shaded/illuminated people coexist. Shadows remain hard and some walls are deliberately artificial occluders.

terrain_realism.finding: Photographic PBR soil/grass/asphalt and irregular mixed transitions improve the primitive baseline. Planar mosaics, repeated/furrowed views and simplified road surfaces remain.

vehicle_recognizability.finding: Shaped cars and truck cabs/cargo, bus roofs/window rows/wheels distinguish classes. Buses and vehicles remain stylized, with simplified surfaces.

judgment: Acceptable improved simplified synthetic imagery; representative scenes are no longer overwhelmingly crude markers/blocks. This is not photorealistic or equivalent to real aerial photography.
